name: Artefact spotlight
description: An optional title card, photographs of an artefact and an optional video, with optional narration and music.

title_card.label: Title card
title_card.help: An opening title video, for example one made with Title Card.

photos.label: Artefact photographs
photos.help: 1 to 12 photographs, shown in order for 5 seconds each.

main_video.label: Main video
main_video.help: An optional video shown after the photographs.

narration.label: Narration
narration.help: Spoken narration, starting with the composition.

music.label: Background music
music.help: Music played under the whole composition, lowered behind other sound.
